title: Two-dimensional arrays
sub: Worksheet for the 360° experience: Two-dimensional lists
objectives: know how to create a two-dimensional array as a list of lists
understand how a row index and a column index together pick out one cell
know how to use two nested loops to total a row, a column or a whole grid
starter: The grid g holds two rows: 4, 9, 2 in the first and 7, 1, 6 in the second. Write down what g[0][2], g[1][0] and len(g) each give, and which row and column hold the 6.
